questions.question: To what extent was 1066 a turning point in English history?

points.text: Significant change: Norman elite replaced Anglo-Saxon, feudalism introduced, language (French influence), church reform, castle-building, Domesday Book. Continuity: shire system, common law roots, parish structure, monarchy institution. Assessment: political/cultural rupture but administrative continuity
